name: vera-script-to-timeline
description: Workspace tooling for VERA Script to Timeline

scripts.test:roadmap: node --test scripts/roadmap.test.mjs scripts/roadmap-rate-limit.test.mjs scripts/roadmap-lock.test.mjs scripts/roadmap-read-gate.test.mjs scripts/roadmap-entrypoints.test.mjs
scripts.test:typescript: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:progress && npm run test:roadmap
scripts.check:typescript: npm run lint:typescript && npm run typecheck:typescript && npm run test:typescript
scripts.lint:python: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.check:python: npm run lint:python && npm run typecheck:python && npm run test:python
scripts.validate: npm run check:contracts-generated && npm run check:typescript && npm run check:python
